verdict.rationale: Docs confirm manual triggering via `meltano run` (meltano-docs-37) and scheduled pipelines orchestrated through Apache Airflow (meltano-docs-7), which implies cron-based scheduling, but no first-party doc explicitly shows configuring sub-hour intervals or cron expressions natively within Meltano's own scheduler. missing for 10: explicit documentation of Meltano's own schedule/cron syntax, examples of sub-hour interval configuration, and confirmation that scheduling doesn't require an external orchestrator like Airflow.
